svg.text: system architecture · a novice pastes a trading-strategy reel; the platform understands it, compiles it onto our existing engine, and returns an honest verdict
② review & edit the draft strategy (human-in-the-loop)
③ read verdict · save to library
· agent + evaluator loop — runs stages 02→05, checks the eval gates, and on a faithfulness / significance failure refines the IR and re-runs (bounded retries)
refine ↺ (re-extract with the failure as feedback)
